sentences.en: They strengthened the embankments to secure the village against floods.
sentences.zh: 他们加固了堤坝以防止村庄遭受洪水侵袭。

sentences.en: The government should strengthen their army once and for all!
sentences.zh: 政府应该彻底加强军队！

sentences.en: Algeria needs to strengthen its ties with Russia and China.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要加强与俄罗斯和中国的合作关系。

senses.zh: 加强，巩固；勉励，激励；增加…的艺术效果

mnemonic: 词根记忆：strength（力量）+en（使…）→（使）有力量→加强
